heroHeadline: Persian Gulf Oil Exports Recover to 72% of Prewar Levels as Iran Deemed 'Exhausted' by Naval Blockade
heroSubtitle: CENTCOM reports over 1 billion barrels of oil have transited the Strait of Hormuz under US passage-protection; US officials say Iran is 'exhausted' by the sustained naval interdiction campaign as Persian Gulf export volumes rebound to 72% of pre-crisis baseline
footerNote: Data sourced from official reports (FAO, World Bank, IMF, IEA, WFP), major outlets (Reuters, Bloomberg, Al Jazeera, CNBC), and institutional analyses (Lloyd's List, S&P Global, IFPRI, Atlantic Council).
